requirements.hint: Studio access: "secured" requires login; "local" is a no-login install that binds loopback only
Email of the first administrator (secured access)
Tenant that owns the first administrator; leave unset to use GATEWAY_BOOTSTRAP_TENANT_ID or the gateway default (kblabs-cloud)
Password of the first administrator; without it no admin is created (recover later with `kb auth reset-admin`)
HMAC secret that signs session tokens (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 64`); without it the gateway uses a public development secret
